facts.fact: eGA says it developed Uganda's Government Enterprise Architecture and e-Government Interoperability Framework with NITA-U about five years before this February 2026 article, which reports NITA-U launching their renewal with World Bank support.

facts.fact: The NITA-U 2022 National IT Survey reports that staff of government MDAs use the internet for backend operations such as accessing IFMIS (75.8% in one table and 70.1% in another), and that 88.4% of MDAs want to use centralised platforms such as IFMIS; the document gives no date for the system's use, so the publication date is used.

note: IFMS is named only as integrated with e-GP for supplier payments; no statement that it is in use across central government.
